decisions.statement: A domain is a page of the `domain` page type rather than a page with a slug.
An edge is a `domain/<slug>` part named by the domain with that part.
A root is a domain no domain names as a part.
A part naming no domain page is drawn and marked rather than passed over.
A slug named that has no domain page throws.
A tree or a subject holding nothing throws rather than answering empty.
A page type is a kind of domain where any type that page type names above that page type is.
A domain open above the point being drawn is marked rather than drawn again.
A domain drawn elsewhere is no domain open above the point being drawn.
Nothing here reads a command line.

definition: the domains read off their pages, drawn as a tree or handed over whole
